title: [Solved] Broken kernel upgrades after copying existing install
body: I upgraded from 7.1.8 to 7.1.9 the other day and observed at least the following - no internet: my ethernet interface disappeared, networkctl only listed the loopback interface - mounting issues: I have a FAT partition for dual-booting with Windows, which started giving mount issues (had to delete it from fstab to be able to boot in the first place) Following https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Genera … el_upgrade , I downgraded the kernel to 7.1.8 sudo pacman -U file://var/cache/pacman/pkg/linux-7.1.8.arch1-3-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst and that fixed the internet and mounting issues. I assumed that was a bug and it would hopefully be fixed soon, but after upgrading to 7.1.11 today I still experience the same issues. What should one do in a case like this? Should I open a bug report? Have I messed something up that I need to fix on my end? Any guidance would be appreciated. Last edited by DeinAlptraum (2026-09-07 13:50:24)
